{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
